paragraphs: Dublin has a new way to check parking. It started on 1 November.
A company called APCOA now does the work for Dublin City Council. Before, another company did it for more than 20 years.
The city now has six areas. Each area has at least one parking officer. Officers will not only work in the city centre. They will also go to places outside the centre.
The parking rules are the same. But there will be more clamps, fines and towing. A local politician said footpaths, bike lanes and bus stops will be clearer. Buses may be faster too.
Jason Cullen is from a group for people who travel to work. He thinks it is a good change. But he worries about the cost of removing a clamp.
sentZh: 都柏林有了檢查停車的新方式。
它從11月1日開始。
一家叫APCOA的公司現在替都柏林市議會做這項工作。
以前是另一家公司做了20多年。
城市現在分成六個區域。
每個區域至少有一名停車管理員。
管理員不會只在市中心工作。
他們也會到市中心以外的地方。
停車規定沒有變。
但上輪鎖、罰款和拖吊會變多。
一位地方政治人物說，人行道、自行車道和公車站會更暢通。
公車可能也會更快。
傑森．卡倫來自一個為通勤者發聲的團體。
他認為這是好的改變。
但他擔心解除輪鎖的費用。

paragraphs: A new system for checking parking in Dublin began on 1 November. Dublin City Council has given the work to a company called APCOA. Before this, Dublin Street Parking Services did the job for more than 20 years, since 2004.

Under the new system, the city is divided into six zones, and each zone has at least one parking officer. Until now, most checks happened in the city centre. Now officers will also visit problem areas across the county, and there will be more focus on towing and fines.

Feljin Jose, a Green Party councillor, said the parking rules are not changing, only the way they are enforced. Officers will respond more to complaints from people in residential areas. He said this should keep footpaths, cycle lanes and bus stops clear and help buses move faster.

Jason Cullen of the Dublin Commuter Coalition expects more clamping outside the city centre. He is worried that the fee to remove a clamp could be a heavy cost for some drivers. Still, he said it is a welcome change to see the rules enforced across the whole city.
sentZh: 都柏林的停車檢查新制度於11月1日開始。
都柏林市議會把這項工作交給一家叫APCOA的公司。
在此之前，都柏林街道停車服務公司從2004年起做了20多年。
在新制度下，城市被分成六個區域，每個區域至少有一名停車管理員。
以往大多數檢查都在市中心進行。
現在管理員也會巡查全郡的問題地區，並更加著重拖吊和罰款。
綠黨議員費爾金．荷西說，停車規定沒有改變，改變的只是執行方式。
管理員將更積極回應住宅區居民的投訴。
他說這應能讓人行道、自行車道和公車站保持暢通，並讓公車行駛得更快。
都柏林通勤者聯盟的傑森．卡倫預期市中心以外的上輪鎖案件會增加。
他擔心解除輪鎖的費用可能對部分駕駛人是沉重負擔。
不過，他說看到規定在全市執行是一個可喜的改變。

paragraphs: Dublin's parking enforcement has been overhauled, with a new system that places greater emphasis on towing and fines coming into force on 1 November. Dublin City Council has awarded the contract to the company APCOA, replacing Dublin Street Parking Services, which had run the service since 2004.

The city has been divided into six enforcement zones, each with at least one dedicated officer. As a result, enforcement will no longer be concentrated in the city centre but will extend to parking black spots throughout the county.

Green Party councillor Feljin Jose said the rules themselves remain the same; what has changed is how they are applied, with more attention to complaints in residential areas. He argued the change would mean clearer footpaths, cycle lanes and bus stops, quicker bus journeys and a more accessible city.

Jason Cullen of the Dublin Commuter Coalition predicted that outer suburbs would see more clamping under the zonal approach. While he raised concerns about the financial burden of clamp removal fees, he described wider enforcement across the city as a welcome development.
sentZh: 都柏林的停車執法已全面改革，更重視拖吊和罰款的新制度於11月1日生效。
都柏林市議會已將合約授予APCOA公司，取代自2004年起經營這項服務的都柏林街道停車服務公司。
城市已被劃分為六個執法區域，每區至少有一名專責人員。
因此，執法將不再集中於市中心，而會擴及全郡的違停熱點。
綠黨議員費爾金．荷西表示，規定本身不變；改變的是執行方式，將更重視住宅區的投訴。
